pages.title: Ice Cream Sort
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Ice Cream Sort asks you to move desserts between shelves and group three identical treats together. Cleared groups reveal more items behind them. Plan the available space and use a shuffle booster when the arrangement makes further sorting difficult.

pages.title: Goods Sorting Shopping Master
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Goods Sorting Shopping Master is a shelf-organizing puzzle with drinks, snacks, and everyday products. Move items to bring three identical goods together and clear them. Keep making useful groups as the mixed shelves reveal more products to sort.

pages.title: Cubica
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Cubica is a block-clearing puzzle in which adjacent cubes of the same color form a match. Click a group of at least two to remove it and make room for new cubes. Study the arrangement without needing to swap individual pieces.

pages.title: Goo Slime Jump
pages.creator: atupdev
pages.description: Goo Slime Jump follows a slime trying to reach the end of a course. Tap to make it jump and time each leap for the route ahead. Keep the creature moving safely until it reaches the finish line.

pages.title: Pixel Number - DIY Coloring
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Pixel Number - DIY Coloring builds pictures from numbered squares. Choose an image and fill each small section with its matching color to reveal the artwork. Work through animal pictures, patterns, and other designs one numbered area at a time.

pages.title: Gal Sliding Puzzle
pages.creator: MOVISOFT.Co.,Ltd
pages.description: Gal Sliding Puzzle asks you to rebuild character pictures by moving tiles into an empty space. Choose a three-, four-, or five-square grid to set the difficulty. Slide neighboring pieces in a useful sequence until the full image is complete.

pages.title: Cheerful Plumber
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Cheerful Plumber is a coloring activity with a plumber, princess, dragon, and other game-inspired characters. Choose shades from two palettes and adjust the brush size for different details. Use the color picker or eraser when revising the picture, then save your result.

pages.title: Snake Out
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Snake Out is a timed puzzle about guiding colored snakes into their holes. Drag snakes of different lengths through the available space and plan the order of movement. Get them all to their destinations before the countdown finishes.

pages.title: Match Collection
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Match Collection asks you to select groups of three matching items from shelves. Your hand holds only seven pieces, so mismatched choices can fill it and end the game. Empty shelves bring the ones above down as you work toward clearing everything.

pages.title: Digging Moles
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Digging Moles makes you carve routes for round moles rolling under gravity. Dig tunnels through the ground so each animal reaches its matching colored pipe. Consider slopes, obstacles, and timing before removing soil that changes the mole's path.

pages.title: Crazy Goose Simulator
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Crazy Goose Simulator puts a troublesome goose into a quiet village with missions to complete. Move through the setting, honk, and take part in the quests that create chaos around the residents. Work through the goose's different assignments.

pages.title: Smoke Trail
pages.creator: GamesByJ
pages.description: Smoke Trail is an endless drifting game about maintaining controlled slides. Keep momentum through the changing track and chain drifts to earn cash. Spend the earnings on more cars, each with different handling characteristics to learn.

pages.title: Fortress of the Sinister
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Fortress Of The Sinister puts a squad into turn-based battles on grid arenas. Recruit distinctive units and plan their movements through four fortresses filled with enemies and traps. Use the team's different abilities to handle each tactical encounter.

pages.title: Save my Hero
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Save My Hero asks you to draw protection against missiles fired by drones. Sketch a shield around the superhero so the incoming rockets cannot reach the character. Test the shape against each level's attack and adjust your approach when needed.

pages.title: Clean House: Clearing trash and dirt
pages.creator: Endless Games
pages.description: Clean House: Clearing Trash And Dirt turns room cleaning into an upgradeable collection task. Vacuum up debris and carry the rubbish to the truck to earn money. Improve the vacuum cleaner so it can handle the growing mess in later rooms.

pages.title: BFF Lovely Kawaii Outfits
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: BFF Lovely Kawaii Outfits lets you style Elsa, Anna, Moana, and Jasmine with kawaii-inspired clothing. Browse each princess's wardrobe and choose coordinating pieces. Try different combinations to give all four friends their own finished look.

pages.title: Save The Sheep
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Save The Sheep is a drawing puzzle about separating a flock from invading wolves. Place wooden stakes by drawing a barrier through the scene. Plan the fence so the predators cannot reach the sheep it is meant to protect.

pages.title: Crazy Traffic Control
pages.creator: Boombit S.A.
pages.description: Crazy Traffic Control makes you manage busy intersections with one-touch signals. Click the control circles to time the movement of cars around crossing traffic, trains, pedestrians, and cows. Allow enough stopping distance to keep the junction clear of collisions.

pages.title: Merge 2048 Gun Rush
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Merge 2048 Gun Rush combines a running course with weapon merging. Slide to guide your collection of guns and join ones of the same level into stronger equipment. Gather more weapons to increase the group's firepower along the route.

pages.title: Ski King 2024
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Ski King 2024 sends you down snowy slopes with obstacles and an avalanche to escape. Follow the suggested route, avoid hazards, and collect coins. Spend the money on skills that change how the skier handles later downhill runs.

pages.title: Pet 5 Diffs
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Pet 5 Diffs asks you to compare two pet pictures and find their changed details. Select the differences or use a hint when an area is difficult to spot. Finish quickly to turn saved time into extra points.

pages.title: Supermarket Paws Cat Game for kids
pages.creator: kid kat
pages.description: Supermarket Paws Cat Game For Kids follows a kitten and its mother through a supermarket. Explore sections for food, clothing, toys, stationery, and other goods. Take part in the store's interactive activities as the pair continue their shopping trip.

pages.title: Royal Society
pages.creator: INFINITE
pages.description: Royal Society follows an invitation to take over a relative's farm in Willow Hills. Manage the property and work through its farming activities to prove you can become the owner. Follow the story to discover why the relative brought you there.

pages.title: Volleyball Challenge
pages.creator: Simplicity Games
pages.description: Volleyball Challenge puts you in a volleyball match with a full range of returns. Serve, bump, block, spike, or lob to send the ball past the opponent. Move into position and choose the right type of hit to win points.

pages.title: City Idle Tycoon
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: City Idle Tycoon lets you buy plots and buildings that produce income. Collect their profits and invest the money in additional properties. Keep expanding the city to create more sources of earnings for the next purchase.

pages.title: Castle Keeper
pages.creator: Lipsar Studio LLC
pages.description: Castle Keeper makes an archer the last defense against invading troops. Shoot the attackers and use ladders or burning barrels to deal extra damage. Upgrade the hero between waves before moving on to defend another castle.

pages.title: Monster School Challenges
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Monster School Challenges puts Noob, Enderman, Herobrine, and other block-world characters through training activities. Work through the school's short challenges using mouse input. Help the students complete the tasks as the class's competition unfolds.

pages.title: Noob vs Pro Zombi Apocalypse
pages.creator: Vally Games
pages.description: Noob Vs Pro Zombi Apocalypse follows two block-world characters after zombies invade. Move through the story's levels and shoot the enemies that threaten their survival. Work through the changing situations while helping Noob and Pro resist the outbreak.

pages.title: Super Wrestlers Slaps Fury
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Super Wrestlers Slaps Fury mixes rapid fighting with a wrestler's growing celebrity. Chain catches, kicks, and punches to defeat challengers while handling the demands of the character's popularity. Keep the action going as you work toward champion status.

pages.title: City Siege
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: City Siege lets you build an army and reclaim streets occupied by hostile troops. Select a unit, move it through the area, and aim at the enemy. Bring heavier equipment into the squad while trying to limit damage to the city.

pages.title: Crazy Falling Ball
pages.creator: tinyDream
pages.description: Crazy Falling Ball challenges you to guide a ball down a steep, changing route. Click or tap to change direction and react to the path ahead. Keep the descent under control so the ball can continue farther down the slope.

pages.title: Maria Adventure
pages.creator: JM Neto Game Dev
pages.description: Maria Adventure follows Maria through a valley of sweets and an enchanted forest toward a castle. Run and jump past the route's challenges while collecting baby items for points. Gather stars as you work through the platform levels.

pages.title: Among Stacky Runner
pages.creator: Yup7.com
pages.description: Among Stacky Runner makes collected yellow blocks your supply for crossing obstacles. Hold to build a ladder when the route rises or a barrier blocks the way. Use the material carefully so enough remains for the next difficult section.

pages.title: Impostor.io
pages.creator: DRA
pages.description: Impostor.io is a melee arena game about defeating other players. Guide your character with the mouse, attack nearby rivals, and use a burst of speed when useful. Running consumes stamina, so manage it while moving between fights.

pages.title: Drop It
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Drop It asks you to slide blocks horizontally and let them fall into new positions. Fill a complete row to remove its blocks and earn points. Look for gaps beside movable pieces and plan how each drop changes the stack.

pages.title: Clock Challenge
pages.creator: Digi Smile limited
pages.description: Clock Challenge tests your timing against a rotating clock hand. Click when the hand reaches the requested number or hour. A correct response speaks the number aloud, combining the reaction challenge with practice reading the clock face.

pages.title: I like OJ Orange Juice
pages.creator: Pupgam Studios
pages.description: I Like OJ puts you in charge of a juicer that should accept only oranges. Hold to open its lid when the right fruit arrives, then close it against carrots, mangoes, and other ingredients. Keep the unwanted food out while making juice.

pages.title: Four Colors Multiplayer
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Four Colors Multiplayer is a card-shedding game against other players or computer opponents. Play a card matching the current color or number, and use action cards to change the round. Remember the one-card button when your hand is nearly empty.

pages.title: Caveman Board Puzzles
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Caveman Board Puzzles challenges you to find the difference between two boards of caveman pictures. Select the changed detail and both boards refresh with another arrangement. Keep spotting differences before the timer expires to build your score.

pages.title: Escape Room Mystery Word
pages.creator: GameZing
pages.description: Escape Room Mystery Word puts you in rooms with doors to unlock. Explore the surroundings, inspect clues, and interact with useful objects while working out each escape. Solve the room's obstacles to open a way onward.

pages.title: The Happiest Fish
pages.creator: Gaboo
pages.description: The Happiest Fish follows a yellow fish swimming through passages filled with food coins, seaweed, and walls. Click or tap to manage its swimming height. Gather the food quickly for more points while keeping the fish clear of obstacles.

pages.title: Where is my ruffled bird
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Where Is My Ruffled Bird makes your drawn lines guide a round bird into a hole. Sketch a route that lets it roll past the obstacles and collect coins. Spend the coins on new birds as you complete forty levels.

pages.title: City Passenger Coach Bus Simulator Bus Driving 3D
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: City Passenger Coach Bus Simulator Bus Driving 3D puts you on timed passenger routes. Pick people up at a bus station and take them to their assigned stop. Steer carefully so the passengers reach the destination safely within the allotted time.

pages.title: Bulldozer Jigsaw
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Bulldozer Jigsaw offers twelve construction-vehicle pictures to assemble. Select a twenty-five, forty-nine, or one-hundred-piece puzzle and drag the pieces into place. Match the machinery's details and edges until the full bulldozer scene is restored.

pages.title: Highway Traffic Racing 2020
pages.creator: MaxZoon
pages.description: Highway Traffic Racing 2020 challenges you to drive through busy highway traffic. Choose a car and customize details such as its color or rims. Weave through the vehicles while keeping enough control to avoid ending the run in a collision.

pages.title: Baby Taylor In The Airport
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Baby Taylor In The Airport follows Taylor's family preparing for a flight. Help pack the luggage and work through the airport activities for her first plane trip. Complete the travel preparations so the family can board successfully.

pages.title: Getting Over It
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Getting Over It follows an older climber trying to reach the top of a mountain. Guide his jumps between the rocks and choose the next foothold carefully. Keep gaining height while avoiding a fall that interrupts the climb.

pages.title: Pandemic Simulator
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Pandemic Simulator puts you in control of a fictional disease spreading across a world map. Develop symptoms and resistance as you try to infect the population. Choose upgrades that help the simulated outbreak reach more of the globe.

pages.title: Wars Z Zombie Apocalypse 2020
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Wars Z Zombie Apocalypse 2020 sends you into missions against different types of zombies. Move, aim, and shoot while completing objectives such as surviving for a time or finding cures. Watch for crawling enemies, zombie dogs, and other attackers.

pages.title: Vehicle Wars Multiplayer 2020
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Vehicle Wars Multiplayer 2020 combines armed combat with tanks, cars, and helicopters. Fight other players, gain experience, and improve your rank to unlock more capable vehicles. Customize the character and weapon camouflage while choosing how to approach the battle.

pages.title: BTS School Bag Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: BTS School Bag Coloring Book gives you school-bag pictures to customize with color. Select shades and apply them to the outlined areas of the design. Try different combinations to make each bag look the way you want.

pages.title: Grid Race
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Grid Race puts a car among blocks to avoid and power-ups to collect. Steer through the available gaps and keep clear of the obstacles. Extend the drive to build your score while gathering useful pickups along the way.

pages.title: GunShoot Gang
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: GunShoot Gang is a pixel-styled shooter with campaign missions and multiplayer battles. Move through jungle and other maps, aim at enemies, and switch weapons as needed. Choose a solo campaign challenge or join friends in the online modes.

pages.title: Perfect Slices Online
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Perfect Slices Online makes you control a knife moving over vegetables. Cut the ingredients for cooking while keeping the blade away from obstacles. Time the chopping carefully to get through the level without hitting something it cannot slice.

pages.title: Merge Balls Blast
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Merge Balls Blast asks you to aim toward balls of the same color and bring them together. Move the arrow to line up the next combination. Keep finding matching colors as the arrangement changes after each merge.

pages.title: The Princess Sisters Coloring
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: The Princess Sisters Coloring offers pictures of two princess sisters and their friends. Choose colors for the outlined artwork and fill the different areas of each image. Experiment with shades to create your own version of the characters.

pages.title: BigHead Wall Run
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: BigHead Wall Run challenges you to keep a character moving across platforms and walls. Click or press the space bar to jump over the next gap or obstacle. Time each leap carefully so the run does not end with a fall.

pages.title: Baby Elsa Puppy Surgery
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Baby Elsa Puppy Surgery is a fictional veterinary-care game for an injured puppy. Wash the animal to examine its injuries, then use the available treatment tools. Finish the care activity by dressing the puppy in an outfit.

pages.title: Zombie Ate All
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Zombie Ate All sends a character running automatically through zombie attacks. Jump with the up arrow and use the attack buttons to defeat enemies. Keep moving safely through the opposition to build a higher score.

pages.title: Running Ninja
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Running Ninja challenges you to extend a ninja's run while gathering stars. React to the course ahead and collect as many stars as possible for points. Keep the character moving farther to improve the score from the previous attempt.

pages.title: Police Motorbike Traffic Rider
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Police Motorbike Traffic Rider lets you ride a motorcycle around a city and attempt stunts. Build speed, look for jumping opportunities, and control the bike through the roads. Use the handbrake when you need to manage a sharp change of direction.

pages.title: Tripolygon
pages.creator: GameNing
pages.description: Tripolygon asks you to rotate a three-colored triangle against incoming bars. Bring the matching color into position to destroy the approaching obstacle. Read the next bar and turn at the right moment to keep progressing.

pages.title: CS War Gun King FPS
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: CS War Gun King FPS is a first-person shooting challenge on city streets. Choose a position, aim with the mouse, and fire at the opposing forces. Grenades and a grenade launcher provide additional attacks when regular gunfire is not enough.

pages.title: Gravity Snowman Christmas
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Gravity Snowman Christmas turns gravity switching into a platform puzzle. Tap to change the snowman's direction of fall and avoid the obstacles along the route. Reach the magic gate to complete each of the thirty levels.

pages.title: Domino Breaker
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Domino Breaker is a physics challenge about knocking down arrangements of dominoes. Aim the first hit to start a chain reaction and watch how far it travels. Clear the required tiles to finish the level and unlock further challenges.

pages.title: Lumberjack Coloring
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Lumberjack Coloring offers eight pictures of lumberjack equipment and related subjects. Choose an image and apply colors to its outlined sections. Use the camera option to download the completed artwork before trying another picture or palette.

pages.title: Kids Farm Fun
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Kids Farm Fun turns lively farm-animal scenes into jigsaw puzzles. Select a picture and a difficulty, then assemble the pieces to reveal the complete illustration. Three settings increase the piece count for a more demanding puzzle.

pages.title: Crazy Car
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Crazy Car puts your vehicle on a road with traffic coming from the opposite direction. Jump the car to avoid approaching cars, trucks, and buses. Watch the spacing between vehicles so you can time the next leap safely.

pages.title: Wrestle Jump 2
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Wrestle Jump 2 pits connected wrestlers against each other in a jumping physics contest. Time your button presses to throw the opponent toward the ground while protecting your own head. Play with another person locally or try the online option.

pages.title: Bus Parking Simulator
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Bus Parking Simulator challenges you to maneuver a large bus into a parking position. Use the driving controls to line up the vehicle and guide it through the available space. Take turns carefully to complete the parking task.

pages.title: 4 Colors Challenge
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: 4 Colors Challenge asks you to catch falling balls with the matching side of a square. Tap either side of the screen to rotate it into position. Check both the incoming color and the square's orientation before the ball arrives.

pages.title: Aeroplane Escape
pages.creator: Restaurant Games
pages.description: Aeroplane Escape puts your aircraft under pursuit from deadly rockets. Steer with the mouse or touch controls to evade the incoming threats. Keep changing the flight path when needed so the plane can stay clear of their approach.

pages.title: Stack Ball Breaker
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Stack Ball Breaker sends a bouncing ball down a tower of platform sections. Press to smash through the breakable pieces, then stop when a deadly section blocks the route. Continue the descent without destroying the ball.

pages.title: Punch Box
pages.creator: Aurora Games
pages.description: Punch Box turns stacked boxes into a boxer's training challenge. Tap on either side to smash the next box while avoiding the sharp wood projecting from some of them. Keep punching efficiently without getting knocked out before time expires.

pages.title: Snow Battle
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Snow Battle is a snowball-fighting battle royale. Move through the arena and challenge the other fighters with snowball attacks. Work toward surviving the contest and unlocking additional character skins as you continue playing.

pages.title: Adam and Eve: Sleepwalker
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Adam And Eve: Sleepwalker follows Adam wandering through a freezing night in his sleep. Interact with objects in each scene to make a safe route onward. Help him through the obstacles and back to bed.

pages.title: Tank Battle : War Commander
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Tank Battle: War Commander is a turn-based strategy game about conquering enemy territory. Command tanks and other heavy weapons, choosing attacks to push the opposing army back. Defend your own country while working toward control of the full map.

pages.title: COLOR_LABYRINTH
pages.creator: Kuanip
pages.description: COLOR_LABYRINTH challenges you to guide a ball through a colored maze. Use the arrow keys to reach the exit while avoiding cubes of a different color. Plan the route around the forbidden blocks before moving into a narrow passage.

pages.title: Zombie Pool
pages.creator: Happylander Ltd
pages.description: Zombie Pool combines pocketing billiard balls with avoiding zombies on the table. Line up shots that send every ball into a pocket without running into the undead obstacles. Consider the ball's path before committing to the stroke.

pages.title: Sudoku Daily
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Sudoku Daily provides a daily number-placement puzzle. Fill the grid with the correct digits while keeping each row, column, and small box free of duplicates. Use the restrictions around an empty cell to work out its value.

pages.title: Tomb Runner
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Tomb Runner follows Professor Jones through temples and other obstacle-filled locations. Run, jump, slide, and move sideways to avoid hazards while collecting gems, coins, and powers. Use your progress to unlock more characters for later runs.

pages.title: Uphill Rush 7: Waterpark
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Uphill Rush 7: Waterpark sends a rider through twisting waterpark courses. Control the movement and tilt through jumps to keep the rider balanced on landing. Work through the route's obstacles while collecting coins and reaching the finish.

pages.title: Mystery Creature Dress Up
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Mystery Creature Dress Up lets you give a magical creature a new appearance. Browse the available clothing and styling options, then combine them into a finished look. Try different selections to create a design for the unusual character.

pages.title: Matching Pattern
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Matching Pattern asks you to find tiles showing the same design and connect them. Scan the colorful board for identical pairs and select their partners. Keep matching the patterns to work through the arrangement.

pages.title: Princess Science Class
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Princess Science Class turns an academy entrance challenge into a science quiz. Read each question and choose an answer to build your score. Use the hint option for help from Sofia and Cedric when a question is difficult.

pages.title: Whack the Phone
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Whack The Phone gives you a virtual smartphone to damage with different tools. Choose a gun, hammer, or baseball bat and apply it to an Apple- or Android-style phone. Experiment with the options in the destruction activity.

pages.title: Draculaura Bad Teeth
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Draculaura Bad Teeth is a fictional dentist game about caring for Draculaura's damaged teeth. Use the available dental tools to work through the character's appointment. Clean and treat the problem areas to complete her fang-care routine.

pages.title: Bonnie Hair Doctor
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Bonnie Hair Doctor follows a fictional salon appointment for a character with a lice problem. Inspect the hair and scalp, then use the available care tools to work through the treatment. Complete the appointment to finish the hair makeover.

pages.title: Princess First Halloween
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princess First Halloween lets you prepare a princess for her first Halloween party. Choose a dress, hairstyle, and makeup for the celebration. After finishing the outfit, decorate a cake to go with the seasonal event.
